periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, sloping towards the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval-ellipsoid, with vertical height approximately 1.5 times the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate downward tapering below the ocular midpoint, resulting in a slightly pyriform or teardrop-shaped profile.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior boundary with minimal indentation at the spinal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, encompassing approximately 30-35% of the visible longitudinal torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation across the cranial vault, exceeding the width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded convex apex with no visible flattening or irregular notches.

other_distinctive_markers: Atypical phenotypic pigmentation where the standard white pelage regions exhibit a distinct light-brown or tan hue.
